author: Boddaert, 1783

months.note: 12월부터 이듬해 4월까지 주로 동해안 앞바다에 머물며, 번식지에서는 6월~8월 상순에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 우리나라 해안에 주로 머무는 겨울철새로, 동해안과 석호, 간척호수, 서해안의 저수지, 남해안과 제주도 등지에서 지낸다. 물고기, 개구리, 갑각류, 연체동물, 물속 곤충 등을 먹는다. 번식지에서는 호수나 습지의 갈대밭에 둥지를 틀고 6월~8월 상순에 알 3~6개를 낳는다. 캄차카, 시베리아 동부, 만주, 사할린, 홋카이도, 북아메리카 등지에서 번식한다.

points.en: breeding: black cap reaching below the eye
winter: neck loses its chestnut colour

sexes.text: 암수 생김새가 같고 수컷이 조금 크다.

young: 어린새는 뺨과 멱이 흐린 황백색 바탕에 흑갈색 줄무늬가 두 줄쯤 있고, 앞목과 목 옆은 연한 적갈색을 띤다. 줄무늬는 가을부터 초겨울 사이에 사라지지만 목의 붉은 기는 이듬해 봄까지 남기도 한다.

art.subject: Red-necked Grebe (Podiceps grisegena), adult in winter (non-breeding) plumage, as seen on Korean coasts and lagoons from November to March: dark grey-brown cap reaching down to eye level; cheeks and throat pale greyish-white, the pale cheek curving up behind the ear coverts; foreneck and hindneck dusky grey, sometimes with a faint rufous tinge; back dark grey-brown; flanks grey-brown; underparts white. Bill long and dagger-shaped, blackish with a yellow base; iris dark brown; legs and lobed toes dark greenish-grey.
art.pose: swimming on calm water, about to dive
art.scene: Korean winter coastal lagoon on the East Sea with calm water; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, side view swimming: black cap down to eye level, pale grey cheeks and throat, deep chestnut neck, dark grey back and flanks, white underparts, yellow-based black bill
adult winter, side view swimming: dusky grey-brown cap and neck without chestnut, pale grey-white cheek and throat curving up behind the ear, dark grey back and flanks, yellow base to the dark bill
art.build: Large, thick-necked grebe, about 47cm, close to a Mallard in length but slimmer and lower in the water. Head rounded with a flattish crown and no plumes. Neck thick and fairly long, often held upright. Bill strong, straight and pointed, about as long as the head. Legs set at the very rear of the body with lobed toes; rarely seen on land. Floats low and dives frequently. At rest the body looks tailless. In flight shows white secondaries and a white patch on the leading edge of the inner wing.
avoid: Do not show the chestnut neck on the winter scene bird; it is lost in winter.
Do not paint a pinkish bill, a white supercilium or head plumes; those mark Great Crested Grebe.
Do not paint a red iris; the iris is dark.
Do not make the neck thin and swan-like; it is short and thick.
